title: The keyboard cannot get around permission or status limits
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" (on another site: the location named in the test run). A second user, signed in a second browser, has the custom role "ZZAUTOTEST C97020 View Only" (Work orders: View only).
  • Technician "ZZAUTOTEST C97020 Ana" is active at this location and is pinned in Board View for both users.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST C97020 Limits" has two work orders led by "ZZAUTOTEST C97020 Ana": unit "C97020-U1", Approved, and unit "C97020-U2", Invoiced. None has a shift on the Schedule.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, "Search" holding "ZZAUTOTEST C97020 Limits", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, browser window at least 1024 px wide, for both users.
  • If any record named above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the second browser (role "ZZAUTOTEST C97020 View Only"), click once in the "Search" box.
  2. Press Tab until a card shows a focus ring.
  3. Use the arrow keys to move the focus ring to the card for unit "C97020-U1".
  4. Press Tab.
  5. Press Enter.
  6. Press Space, then Shift with each arrow key.
  7. In your own browser ("Admin" role), click once in the "Search" box.
  8. Press Tab until a card shows a focus ring.
  9. Use the arrow keys to move the focus ring to the card for unit "C97020-U2".
  10. Press Tab.
  11. Press Enter.
  12. Choose "Reassign lead technician" with the arrow keys and press Enter.
  13. Press Escape.
  14. Press Space, then Shift with each arrow key.
  15. Refresh the page.
  16. Click the card for unit "C97020-U2".
custom_expected:
Step 1: the cursor is in the "Search" box.

Step 2: a card shows the focus ring.

Step 3: the card for unit "C97020-U1" shows the focus ring.

Step 4: if the card has a "More actions" (…) button, it now has the focus; otherwise focus leaves the board.

Step 5: "Reassign lead technician" cannot be reached: no menu opens, or it is not offered, or it is disabled and nothing happens.

Step 6: no key moves unit "C97020-U1"; it keeps its place and its lead, "ZZAUTOTEST C97020 Ana".

Step 7: the cursor is in the "Search" box.

Step 8: a card shows the focus ring.

Step 9: the card for unit "C97020-U2" shows the focus ring.

Step 10: the card's "More actions" (…) button shows and has the focus.

Step 11: the menu opens and "Reassign lead technician" is disabled, with the note "The lead technician can’t be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid."

Step 12: nothing happens; no dialog opens.

Step 13: the menu closes.

Step 14: no key moves unit "C97020-U2" to another technician.

Step 15: Board View shows unit "C97020-U2" in "ZZAUTOTEST C97020 Ana"'s column.

Step 16: the work order page opens and "Lead Technician" reads "ZZAUTOTEST C97020 Ana".
